image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, wet rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a dark, leathery girdle surrounding a central series of segmented plates. The surface appears wet and textured.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the organism is visible and lacks any protruding sensory structures like eyes or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the animal blends smoothly into the girdle without a distinct head shape, appearing blunt as expected.
There are no antennae, eyestalks, or other sensory appendages visible on the dorsal surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A central column of segmented, overlapping plates is clearly visible running down the midline of the body. While exact counting is difficult due to lighting/wetness, the structural arrangement of multiple serial plates is evident.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are surrounded by a distinct, textured mantle/girdle that appears leathery and covers the lateral margins of the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a dark, mottled grey-brown coloration that blends with the rocky environment, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal view; the ventral foot is completely occluded by the body against the rock.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism lies flat against the rock surface with no significant elevation, demonstrating the characteristic flattened profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral trait not observable in a static image of an attached specimen.
